facts.text: Audrey shared a photo of two dogs snuggling on her favorite blanket.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of them snuggling on my favorite blanket.

facts.text: Audrey stated that the two dogs always sleep together, especially when it's time to nap.

evidence.quote: They always sleep like that. They cuddle up together, especially when it's time to nap.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that each of the dogs has a favorite spot to chill, including a couch, a bed, a chair, and a rug.

evidence.quote: They each have their favorite spot to chill. Pepper loves lounging on the couch, Pixie always curls up in her bed, Precious has her chair, and Panda loves to relax on his rug!

facts.text: Andrew expressed that having furry friends who keep each other company is awesome.

evidence.quote: Wow that's awesome! It must be great having furry friends to keep each other company.
